expectations.query: SELECT count(*) FROM (VALUES 'ma_chuong_trinh', 'nam_hoc', 'hoc_ky', 'ty_le_qua_hoc_phan', 'gpa_trung_binh', 'ty_le_dung_tien_do', 'source_record_id', 'source_updated_at', 'source_record_checksum') AS required(column_name) WHERE column_name NOT IN (SELECT column_name FROM lakehouse.information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'gold' AND table_name = 'learning_outcomes_metrics')
SELECT CAST(count_if(ma_chuong_trinh IS NULL OR nam_hoc IS NULL OR hoc_ky IS NULL OR source_record_id IS NULL OR source_record_checksum IS NULL) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(count(*), 0) FROM {data_asset_ref}
SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM {data_asset_ref} GROUP BY ma_chuong_trinh, nam_hoc, hoc_ky HAVING count(*) > 1)
SELECT count_if(ty_le_qua_hoc_phan < 0 OR ty_le_qua_hoc_phan > 100 OR ty_le_dung_tien_do < 0 OR ty_le_dung_tien_do > 100) FROM {data_asset_ref}
